ios.desc:
FeatherArc is a focused badminton journal for players who want every match, training session, and moment of progress beautifully organized in one private place.
Designed for badminton, built for Apple devices, and made to feel personal from the very first session.

CAPTURE EVERY SESSION
Log singles, doubles, and training sessions with clarity. Track time on court, record match results, save personal notes, and build a complete history of how you play over time.
Whether it was a casual rally, a serious match, or a focused training day, FeatherArc keeps the details easy to record and easy to revisit.

KNOW YOUR RIVALS
Add rivals, remember how they play, and keep notes on their strengths, weaknesses, and habits.
Fast smasher. Weak backhand. Loves drop shots. Struggles under pressure.
FeatherArc helps you walk onto the court with context, not just memory.

SEE THE FULL PICTURE
Every session can include rich workout details such as intensity, heart rate, location, weather, and time on court.
More than a scorebook, FeatherArc gives you a complete view of each session — how you played, how hard you worked, and what the conditions were like.

SCORE FROM YOUR WATCH
Use Apple Watch to control the score while your iPhone becomes a clear, shareable scoreboard.
Place your iPhone courtside and let everyone see the score, even if your opponent does not have an Apple Watch. Simple, visible, and made for real games.

FINISH ON IPHONE
Start from Apple Watch, stay focused during play, and complete the details later on iPhone.
Your workout data and score come across automatically. Just add the opponent, notes, or extra session details when you are done.
Play first. Organize later.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from preset themes or create your own with custom colors.
Your sessions, widgets, Apple Watch experience, and light or dark mode can all follow your style — perfect for players who care about how their Home Screen, Watch face, and apps look together.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your badminton history belongs to you.
FeatherArc stores your records on your devices and syncs them with iCloud through your Apple account. No separate account, no unnecessary tracking, no custom server holding your journal.
Your progress stays personal, secure, and under your control.

BUILT FOR THE LONG GAME
FeatherArc is for players who want more than scattered memories.
